claims.quote: The 'arulius' barb, Dawkinsia tambraparniei, is a cyprinid possibly restricted to the middle Tambraparni River basin in Tamil Nadu, southern India.

regions.name: Tambraparni
regions.quote: Type locality is 'Stream 7 miles from Kalladaikurichi, Tambraparni watershed, Tinnevelly District, Madras State, India', and this species is possibly restricted to middle parts of the Tambraparni River basin.

regions.name: Western Ghats
regions.quote: The Tambraparni arises in the Western Ghats mountains and flows through the state of Tamil Nadu in southern India, eventually emptying into the Gulf of Mannar.
